# Compiler errors that the native half ALREADY produces on main.
#
# main does not compile. This was not known before the first CI run on this repository, because
# scripts/build_native_fs_guard.sh exits on any non-Darwin host and the stations were the only thing
# that ever built the native half — which is exactly why PRs have been able to hold hundreds of Swift
# lines reviewed "by shape and call-site analysis only".
#
# Listing them here does NOT make them acceptable. It makes the native job useful in spite of them.
# Every target NOT blocked by an entry below is compiled individually and required to be clean, so a
# newly introduced compile error in those targets fails on the first run that introduces it. The job
# also fails when a blocked target starts building cleanly, so this file cannot outlive the defects it
# describes.
#
# Format: <repo-relative source file>: <clang/swift message, truncated at the first ';'>
# Line and column numbers are deliberately NOT part of the signature — they move whenever anything
# above them is edited, and a signature that churns is a signature nobody maintains. The cost of that
# choice, stated plainly: a SECOND occurrence of an already-listed message in the same file is not
# distinguishable from the first, so it would not be caught.
#
# Measured on macos-latest = macOS 26.4, Apple Swift 6.3.2, Xcode 26.5, SDK MacOSX26.5.sdk.
# Runs 30302342895 (the C errors) and 30305062756 (the Swift errors).
#
# WHAT IS BLOCKED BY THIS FILE, derived automatically from `swift package dump-package`:
#   RecordingsVerifierLauncher, RecordingsUpdateBroker, RecordingsUpdateBrokerTests   (the C errors)
#   RecordingsUpdateProtocol, RecordingsUpdateClient, RecordingsEnvelopeSigner,
#   RecordingsBootstrapPreflight, RecordingsUpdateProtocolTests                       (the Swift ones)
# WHAT IS STILL GATED, i.e. required to compile cleanly on every PR:
#   RecordingsLib, App, RecordingsTests — the bulk of the Swift, including the 21-file test target.

# --- Updater/VerifierLauncher (C) -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two missing DECLARATIONS, not missing functionality, and neither is safe to fix blind: `closefrom`
# is hidden unless the translation unit opts into the full Darwin C level, and
# `sandbox_init_with_parameters` is a private SPI absent from the public sandbox.h, so it needs a local
# prototype that has to match Apple's exactly. Getting that prototype wrong in a privilege-separation
# launcher is undefined behaviour rather than a compile error, so it is filed as its own change rather
# than fixed inside a CI pull request. See todos 9204bd93.
src/native/Recordings/Updater/VerifierLauncher/RecordingsVerifierLauncher.c: call to undeclared function 'closefrom'
src/native/Recordings/Updater/VerifierLauncher/RecordingsVerifierLauncher.c: call to undeclared function 'sandbox_init_with_parameters'

# --- Updater/Protocol (Swift) -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Four instances of one real type error at UpdateProtocol.swift:111-117. `NSXPCInterface.setClasses`
# takes a `Set<AnyHashable>`, and a metatype does not implicitly convert to `AnyHashable`, so
# `[FileHandle.self]` does not typecheck as a set literal. This is an XPC interface whitelist for the
# updater's privileged helper — the allowed argument classes for installWithArchive:manifest:envelope:
# — so it is security-relevant and belongs in the same change as the launcher fix, not here.
src/native/Recordings/Updater/Protocol/UpdateProtocol.swift: cannot convert value of type 'FileHandle.Type' to expected element type 'Set<AnyHashable>.ArrayLiteralElement' (aka 'AnyHashable')
src/native/Recordings/Updater/Protocol/UpdateProtocol.swift: cannot convert value of type 'NSDictionary.Type' to expected element type 'Set<AnyHashable>.ArrayLiteralElement' (aka 'AnyHashable')
src/native/Recordings/Updater/Protocol/UpdateProtocol.swift: cannot convert value of type 'NSNumber.Type' to expected element type 'Set<AnyHashable>.ArrayLiteralElement' (aka 'AnyHashable')
src/native/Recordings/Updater/Protocol/UpdateProtocol.swift: cannot convert value of type 'NSString.Type' to expected element type 'Set<AnyHashable>.ArrayLiteralElement' (aka 'AnyHashable')
